Our guards maintain the peace in the village and work day and night to protect the residents from ferocious beasts or orcs, just like the lighthouse works constantly to protect ships from the rocks. links.text: See the Lord and get the tax rate information.

guard/30039-1.htm.text: Captain Gilbert: The lighthouse was built by the Elves long ago, to safely guide ships and their crews to Talking Island. Now Rockswell manages the lighthouse. For the past thirty years, he hasn't missed a night, and so the sea is lit by the lighthouse's beams.

Q00257_TheGuardIsBusy/30039-04.html.text: Captain Gilbert: You cannot hope for any reward if you laze around in the village. Go outside the village immediately and join in on the hunt. Q00257_TheGuardIsBusy/30039-03.htm.text: Captain Gilbert: Go and slay orcs and werewolves that live on Talking Island, and bring back proof of their deaths. Prizes will be awarded according to the amount of proof that you bring back. Bring back the feather Orc Amulet, werewolf fangs, or the Orc's Necklace that orcs of fighter rank carry. …

Q00257_TheGuardIsBusy/30039-05.html.text: Captain Gilbert: You have done well. May the blessings of Einhasad be with you.

Q00257_TheGuardIsBusy/30039-06.html.text: Captain Gilbert: Please continue, then. Pretty soon, our Talking Island will be a suitable place for peaceful citizens to live in, free of violent orcs and vicious werewolves.
